caption: The drawing is a monochromatic, light gray depiction featuring various objects and characters evenly distributed across the upper half of the page, enclosed within a faint rectangular border. At the top, there are rows of capital letters, numbers, and decorative symbols arranged in straight lines, with the numbers "1820" visible among them. Beneath the text, there are symmetrical groups of motifs, including two urns with large, outstretched leaves or feathers, birds, a large tree, a crab-like figure on the left, and a variety of geometric and floral shapes. In the central region, there is a heart-shaped element inscribed with "Anno 1820," and several human figures in traditional dress are seen below this, spaced apart and facing forward. Additional motifs include small hearts, more floral arrangements, mushrooms, and other small decorative figures. The entire composition sits on a lightly colored, almost off-white background, and there is a double border, one thin and inner, and a broader outer margin on the paper. The drawing utilizes only shades of gray, indicating either pencil or ink as the medium.
title: Sampler
